# source => result, or error:diagnostic
let read = 1 << 0; let write = 1 << 2; (read | write) & write => 4
1 << 0 => 1
1 << 2 => 4
1 << 1 + 1 => 4
1 + 1 << 2 => 8
1 << 2 & 6 => 4
1 << 1 << 1 => 4
1 << 2 == 4 => 1
1 < 2 << 1 => 1
fn bit(n) { 1 << n }; bit(3) => 8
match 1 { 1 => 1 << 2, _ => 0 } => 4
if 1 << 1 == 2 { 9 } else { 0 } => 9
0 && 1 << (1 / 0) => 0
1 || 1 << (1 / 0) => 1
0 && 1 << => error:expected integer
1 << => error:expected integer
[1] << 1 => error:expected integer
1 << [1] => error:expected integer
1 << -1 => error:integer overflow
-1 << 1 => error:integer overflow
1 << 1 / 0 => error:division by zero
